intro: The excavators broke the seal on a tomb that appears on no dynasty list. Every chamber is empty except for a single inscription, carved in a script that is not quite hieroglyphic.
echo: The beetle rolls its ball across the sand the way Khepri rolls the sun.

puzzles.title: Book Of The Dead
puzzles.flavor: Some letters stand tall; most stay low.

blocks.text: ThoTH LuXor TemPLe amuleT NiLe NeFertITI lotus cANopIc NefeRTiTi.

hints: Two kinds of letter, big and small. How many of them would you need to spell twenty-six different things?
Baconian cipher: groups of five, lowercase = a, uppercase = b; aaaaa is A.

puzzles.title: The Inundation
puzzles.flavor: Everything fell straight down, and landed in the right column.
hints: Black squares are spaces. Which two- and three-letter words fit, using only the letters each column allows?
Each column's letters drop into that column of the grid; cross them off as you place them. The sentence tells you what to submit.

puzzles.title: Hall Of Records
puzzles.flavor: Only one page survived. It was the only page anyone needed.

blocks.text: The excavators broke the seal on a tomb that appears on no dynasty list. Every chamber is empty except for a single inscription, carved in a script that is not quite hieroglyphic.

hints: The first number in each pair never goes past the number of words on the page. What does the second count?
The first number finds a word on the page; the second finds a letter in it.

puzzles.title: The Rosetta Problem
puzzles.flavor: Not a single letter on the page, and yet it says something.
hints: Which short words are most common in English? Could any of them be hiding here?
Each symbol always stands for the same letter. The finished sentence tells you what to submit.

puzzles.title: Weighing Of The Heart

blocks.text: QEFP MXDB EXP HBMQ FQP PBZOBQ CLO X SBOV ILKD QFJB XKA QEXQ PBZOBQ FP OXJPBP

hints: Try moving every letter the same distance. How far turns the short words into English?
A Caesar shift: find the one shift that fixes a short word, then apply it everywhere.

puzzles.title: False Door
puzzles.flavor: Nothing is missing. Nothing is where it was.
hints: Each word is complete but shuffled. Start with the shortest ones: does a sentence appear?
Unscramble each word where it stands; the sentence tells you what to submit.

meta.title: Meta: Valley Of The Kings
meta.flavor: Pigeonholes, each cut to fit one thing only.
hints: The grid's rows are all different lengths. So are your answers.
Put each answer in the row its length fits; read the shaded squares top to bottom.
